scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 six-costume-accessory count reconciliation
verification_policy: Reconcile the official six-item category count against named PQ inventory entries without inventing missing names. A named item is not promoted to verified acquisition until its reward conditions are independently established.

sources.scope: Chapter 4 DLC identity and launch content

count_reconciliation.note: The official category count is six, while the currently accessible PQ inventory explicitly names five costume/accessory/set entries. The remaining one is not fabricated or inferred from character appearance, promotional imagery, or video thumbnails.

important_identity_rules: Do not automatically expand a Set entry into separate equipment records without item-level evidence.
Do not assume a Set entry is equivalent to the character Clothes entry.
Do not use the official count to guess the missing item's name.
Do not treat DLC ownership as the same thing as an individual item's unlock condition.
Do not assign Normal versus Ultimate Finish reward ownership from the ordering of a secondary guide.
research_targets: Identify the sixth costume/accessory record from item-level or equivalent evidence.
Determine whether Fu (Ultra Supervillain) Set and Fu Set 2 are single inventory records or shorthand for component equipment.
Reconcile all six records with exact PQ reward conditions.
Determine whether any of the six are obtainable outside PQ 185/186 through later shop, event, raid, or other distribution routes.
nonclaims: No missing item name is inferred.
No Normal versus Ultimate Finish mapping is inferred.
No internal item ID is inferred.
